topic: ADS Bolt and bolt-action scoped cadence candidates
scope: Six exact bolt-action site weapons. Four current site weapons expose the ads_bolt choice. Multiplayer/runtime effects remain unproven.

externalDetail.correctionNote: Per-weapon rawFloat32Hex values were validated as slices of hashed raw bodies. This includes corrected M2010 ESR BoltActionSpeed 39a8833f at 716 and Mini Scout 3b586e3f at 716; stale values in the owner-selector detail are not reused.

effectiveDefaultAdsRows.method: Executed current resetAttsForWeapon + applyAttachments with source-neutral default attachments.

confirmedSource.reconSelectorBinding: Class_897c99a7/Field_819acc98/0; the same selector is bound to WM_ReconTrait and each of the six rifle modifier entries. This establishes selector identity, not native composition.
confirmedSource.siteBehavior: The site marks ads_bolt noEffect=true. The WME proves a source boolean but has no numeric timing/speed operand; P25 is not evidence of a 25% value.

siteModel.comparison: Current Analyzer RPM for all six matches the primary WB formula within 0.01 RPM.
siteModel.adsBoltConsumer: sim/applyAttachments.js:580-581 falls through to w.rpm for non-auto/non-burst; sim/core.js:230-231 uses 60/weaponRpm(w) as normal shot interval. No ads_bolt cadence branch.

candidateRoles.zoomFraction: BoltActionTimeCompletedFractionZoom may shorten the firing gate, or may only gate when ADS can resume during bolting. Preserve both hypotheses; no runtime relation established.
candidateRoles.recon: Secondary Class_582cbe36 timing is selector-bound to Recon. Its time=-1 could be inherited while speed/fractions modify timing; -1 is not treated as inactive. Composition remains unresolved.
candidateRoles.adsOut: Aout is unmeasured. Do not assign IDA as ADS-out timing; IDA is established only as the ADS ladder minus one 60 Hz frame within rounding.
candidateRoles.noDlcPredictions: Serial: mechanical cycle+Ain+Aout. Partial overlap: max(mechanical cycle,Aout)+Ain. Full overlap: max(mechanical cycle,Aout+Ain). Zoom-resume alternative: max(existing mechanical cycle, Zoom-fraction resume boundary + modeled ADS-in) plus measured ADS-out/start offset.
capture: Use fixed input and five accepted shot intervals; timestamp accepted shots, ADS-off, bolt start/end, Zoom-fraction boundary, ADS-on and next shot.
Test hip vs held ADS with/without DLC Bolt only on the four mapped choices.
Run Recon independently; do not conflate its selector with DLC Bolt.
Measure ADS-out directly; no numerical Aout is asserted.

limits: Source presence is not runtime proof.
The WME flag does not identify whether cycle, ADS transition, bolt-phase eligibility, or another state changes.
Default Ain values are effective Analyzer outputs for default attachment loadouts, not raw unmodified ADS input; ADS speed is loadout dependent.
Firing interval and transition phase overlap require controlled gameplay capture.
